units.rawText: A sudden sound wakes me from my dreams.
units.displayText: A sudden sound wakes me from my dreams.

spans.text: A sudden sound wakes me from my dreams.

units.rawText: The sense of disconnection between my mind and body fills me with dizziness, and it feels as though the earth was shifting beneath my feet. My memories and rationality slowly piece themselves together within my consciousness as I slowly get up while grabbing my head.
units.displayText: The sense of disconnection between my mind and body fills me with dizziness, and it feels as though the earth was shifting beneath my feet. My memories and rationality slowly piece themselves together within my consciousness as I slowly get up while grabbing my head.

spans.text: The sense of disconnection between my mind and body fills me with dizziness, and it feels as though the earth was shifting beneath my feet. My memories and rationality slowly piece themselves together within my consciousness as I slowly get up while grabbing my head.

units.rawText: The Ops Room is empty, and nobody answers my question. I look around and see the rays of the blazing sun streaming in from outside the window. It is only then that I finally regain a sense of groundedness amidst the strange wave of unreality that seems to have overcome me.

units.rawText: —And right after that, I notice the source of the sound that woke me up.
units.displayText: —And right after that, I notice the source of the sound that woke me up.

spans.text: —And right after that, I notice the source of the sound that woke me up.

units.rawText: I open my communicator, and the contents within are just as unreal as what I felt before.
units.displayText: I open my communicator, and the contents within are just as unreal as what I felt before.

units.rawText: Before I can figure out the meaning of this mail, another one follows right after it—
